objective.name: sandbox.cpp.bad_build
objective.description: Compiled wrapper-backed capacity used to prove build failure fail-closed behavior

#root.role: Select a compiled wrapper configuration that fails during build and expose the fail-closed execution path.

effects.wrapper_build: The compiled wrapper build path is exercised and expected to fail closed.

transformation_contract.morphing: A compiled execution request becomes a fail-closed build error path when the selected wrapper cannot build.
invariants: sandbox.cpp.bad_build must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.cpp.bad_build returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.cpp.bad_build fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
